background.source: La Traviata is an opera in three acts by Giuseppe Verdi, based on the play La Dame aux camélias by Alexandre Dumas fils, adapted from his own novel. Originally titled Violetta, the opera tells the story of Margaret, a wealthy and well-educated prostitute who falls in love with a member of the bourgeoisie. Despite societal pressures and tragic circumstances, their love is immortalized through Verdi's stunning score. Though the opera was intended to be set in contemporary times, it was initially staged in the 1700s at the insistence of La Fenice opera house authorities. Despite this setback, La Traviata has become one of the most beloved operas of all time, with realistic productions finally being staged in the 1880s.
